2026_01_CLE_JAX.headline: Cleveland’s Watson reset faces a Jacksonville defense that can force patience
2026_01_CLE_JAX.paragraph1: Cleveland starts the Todd Monken era with Deshaun Watson back under center after a long injury absence, but the Browns are already without guard Teven Jenkins and could be thin inside if center Parker Brailsford cannot go. Jacksonville can lean on that uncertainty by making Cleveland sustain drives rather than live on broken plays. The Jaguars’ own offense still needs consistency from Trevor Lawrence and the run game, so this matchup could turn on which quarterback handles pressure and third down with fewer negative plays.
2026_01_CLE_JAX.model_rationale: Jacksonville can test Cleveland’s protection and force Watson to win repeatedly from structure, while the Browns need their defense to create short fields and keep the game compressed.
